howto.what: 装上后，当你要开发DeFi协议时，Claude会直接给出可用于质押、AMM等场景的Solidity合约模板代码，并指向详细的模式库文件，方便你直接参考实现。
howto.when: 当你在构建DeFi应用或智能合约协议，尤其是涉及质押、AMM、治理等场景时，这个技能会被触发。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you develop DeFi protocols, Claude will provide Solidity contract templates for staking, AMMs, etc., and point to a detailed pattern library for reference.
howto.when_en: Triggered when building DeFi applications or smart contract protocols, especially for staking, AMMs, governance, or flash loans.

say_en.text: Give me a Solidity template for a staking rewards contract
Write a simple AMM swap contract for me
What governance templates are in references/details.md?
